description: February 4 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 4 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the second decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: February 4 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Halfway through Aquarius's Mercury decan, roughly fifteen degrees into the sign, February 4 carries the steady 4. Numerology links it with diligence and solid foundations. Here that discipline is applied to ideas, so the person is often pictured as an engineer of concepts: unconventional in vision, careful and thorough in execution.

On February 4 the Sun usually sits at about 15° Aquarius, in the second decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Uranus. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aquarius the sub-ruler is Mercury, the ruler of Gemini. Birthdays from around January 30 to February 8 tend to bring a quick, communicative intelligence to the sign's idealism. Natives are often seen as witty, curious and well networked, the kind of person who knows someone in every group and enjoys connecting them. Writing, teaching and technical problem-solving are commonly associated with this decan. Mercury can make the mind race ahead of the body and the heart. Slowing down long enough to listen as well as explain usually deepens their many connections.

sections.heading: February 4 in numerology
paragraphs: A 4th-of-the-month birthday gives a birthday number of 4, with no further reduction needed. In numerology the birth day acts as a supplementary number, describing practical talents that sit beside the Life Path. The 4 stands for the square: four walls, four seasons, a stable base. Anyone born on the 4th is often pictured as organised, trustworthy and good at turning plans into schedules. They tend to prefer a method that has been tested to one that merely sounds exciting. The growing edge for 4s is usually flexibility, letting the structure bend when circumstances genuinely change.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 4 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 4: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 4 is the 35th day of the year. By February 19, 15 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Pisces.

For the Chinese zodiac, February 4 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 58 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal. Well-known people born on February 4 include Rosa Parks (1913), Dan Quayle (1947) and Ludwig Erhard (1897).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 4?
faq.answer: February 4 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 4?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 4 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 4th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 4?
faq.answer: February 4 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 58 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 4?
faq.answer: February 4 is also the birthday of Rosa Parks (1913), Dan Quayle (1947) and Ludwig Erhard (1897). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
